plan.title: AskUserQuestion dialog: show issue title alongside identifier, and make agent questions self-contained
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: Operators answer AskUserQuestion prompts without the context the agent assumed: the dialog shows only a bare issue identifier ('MIN-663' or the literal 'Unknown'), the Needs-you decision surfaces show either identifier-only or title-only labels, and agents write questions ('Should I go with option B?') that assume the reader has the transcript they cannot see from the dialog.
narratives.Proposal: Add a shared formatIssueRef helper and an issueTitle field on AskUserQuestionSubject so the dialog, the DecisionsPanel Needs-you list, and the SessionFeedSidebar needs-you rows all render '<issueId> — <issue title>', with titles joined client-side from resolver-fed store issues (no new store/tracker access). Ship self-contained-question guidance as a scope:universal bundled rule (reaching work, plan, and conversation roles on all harnesses via pan sync), reinforced in the planning prompt and plan role, and document the pipeline in docs/ASKUSERQUESTION-DASHBOARD.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Rendering a transcript snippet of the agent's most recent message in the dialog (issue marked it optional; needs a transcript read path the dialog lacks)
- Any new REST endpoint, tracker call, or direct DB/store read for issue titles
- Changing the meaning or population of the existing subject.title field (agent toast labels depend on it)
- Editing rendered harness context files (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md managed region, pi-global.md, codex-global.md) — only the sync-sources rule source
- Changing the AUQ hook's deny/restate contract or its load-bearing REASON string
- Server-side changes to /api/conversations/pending-input or the agents read model

autoDecisions.summary: Resolve issue titles by client-side join against store issues (selectIssues/issuesRaw) rather than adding a server endpoint.
autoDecisions.rationale: issuesRaw is already fed by the canonical issues resolver over /ws/rpc; joining in the frontend adds zero new store access and matches the existing pattern at usePendingInputDialogs.ts:144 and SessionFeedSidebar.tsx:201-207.

autoDecisions.summary: When a subject is unbound (no issueId), omit the dialog's Issue cell instead of rendering the literal 'Unknown'; when bound but the title does not resolve, show the identifier alone.
autoDecisions.rationale: The AC forbids an 'Unknown' regression; a cell that says 'Unknown' carries no information, and identifier-alone is the stated fallback for unresolvable titles.

autoDecisions.summary: Deliver self-contained-question guidance as a scope:universal bundled rule plus planning-prompt/plan-role reinforcement, rather than editing every role file.
autoDecisions.rationale: The AC requires the guidance to reach work, plan, and conversation roles; the bundled-rule pipeline is the one mechanical carrier that reaches all three on every harness, and the planning prompt is the heaviest AUQ user.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the agent subject's title field overloaded with the issue title; add issueTitle alongside instead of repurposing it.
autoDecisions.rationale: Toast and notification labels at usePendingInputDialogs.ts:279,435,443,503,515 read title; a surgical additive field avoids regressing them.

Universal bundled rule: self-contained AskUserQuestion prompts

narrative.Action: Per PRD W6: create sync-sources/rules/ask-user-question-self-contained.md with scope: universal frontmatter, matching the terse imperative voice of neighboring rules. Body: every AskUserQuestion must stand alone because the operator answers from a dashboard dialog without the transcript — 1-2 sentences of situation, the decision in plain language, and option descriptions that state the consequence of choosing them; include the one-line WHY. Do NOT run pan sync or edit rendered harness context files (hazard H4) — the rule ships with the package and renders on install/sync.
